# Terminal User Interfaces with ratatui

When a simple line-based CLI is not expressive enough, full-screen Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) allow interactive dashboards, data tables, split panes, and real-time monitoring graphs. `ratatui` (the community fork of `tui-rs`) is the premier TUI framework in Rust.

## Adding `ratatui` and `crossterm`

In `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[dependencies]
ratatui = "0.26"
crossterm = { version = "0.27", features = ["event-stream"] }
```

- `crossterm`: Low-level cross-platform terminal manipulation (alternate screens, raw mode, keyboard/mouse events).
- `ratatui`: Immediate-mode UI layout engine, widgets, styling, and rendering abstractions.

## Raw Mode and Alternate Screen Lifecycle

A TUI must enter raw mode (disabling line buffering and OS echo) and switch to an alternate screen buffer, restoring the user's previous terminal state upon exit:

```rust
use std::io::{self, stdout};
use crossterm::{
    execute,
    terminal::{disable_raw_mode, enable_raw_mode, EnterAlternateScreen, LeaveAlternateScreen},
};
use ratatui::prelude::*;

pub struct TerminalGuard;

impl TerminalGuard {
    pub fn enter() -> io::Result<Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>> {
        enable_raw_mode()?;
        let mut stdout = stdout();
        execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen)?;
        let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
        Terminal::new(backend)
    }
}

impl Drop for TerminalGuard {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = disable_raw_mode();
        let _ = execute!(stdout(), LeaveAlternateScreen);
    }
}
```

## Immediate-Mode Rendering Loop

`ratatui` recalculates and renders the interface every frame based on the current application state:

```rust
use ratatui::{
    layout::{Constraint, Direction, Layout},
    style::{Color, Style},
    widgets::{Block, Borders, Paragraph},
    Frame,
};

struct AppState {
    counter: usize,
    status_message: String,
}

fn ui(frame: &mut Frame, state: &AppState) {
    let chunks = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([
            Constraint::Length(3),
            Constraint::Min(0),
            Constraint::Length(3),
        ])
        .split(frame.size());

    let header = Paragraph::new("Rust Production TUI Monitor")
        .style(Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan))
        .block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL));
    frame.render_widget(header, chunks[0]);

    let body = Paragraph::new(format!("Tasks Processed: {}", state.counter))
        .block(Block::default().title("Active Workload").borders(Borders::ALL));
    frame.render_widget(body, chunks[1]);

    let footer = Paragraph::new(state.status_message.as_str())
        .style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))
        .block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL));
    frame.render_widget(footer, chunks[2]);
}
```
